description: Use this when someone asks how much their vet clinic has taken in, or how many payments succeeded, failed or were canceled. Returns totals and counts by currency and status for one page of payments, newest first (20 by default), with a cursor for the rest (no client, pet or card data). Not for refunds or charging a client.

clinicId.description: Only this clinic (24 lowercase hexadecimal characters); every clinic when absent

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page with the same filters; absent for the first page

endTime.description: Only payments dated before this ISO 8601 date-time

limit.description: Payments to summarize in this page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 20

startTime.description: Only payments dated at or after this ISO 8601 date-time

name: list_payments

moreRecordsAvailable.description: True when older payments exist beyond this page

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page

recordsSummarized.description: How many payment records this page summarized

totals.description: One row per currency and status within this page only. Transaction identifiers and dates, animal or owner linkage, line items, discounts, payment methods, card or bank data and processor identifiers are never returned.

title: Summarize payments received
